basic_info.description: A rare opportunity to live at The Bellaire Tower, a historic Art Deco San Francisco Landmark in Russian Hill. The southeast corner living room provides abundant natural light throughout the day, showcasing iconic views of San Francisco and the downtown skyline. Apartment 302 features generously sized rooms and private office space. The Bellaire Tower provides security of 24-hour door persons and valet parking. Russian Hill is renowned for its charm and is close to some of the city's best cuisine for quintessential San Francisco living.
